svg.title: Compare both inputs and edit the merge result in VS Code
svg.desc: 1: README is listed under Merge Changes until its conflict is resolved. 2: Read both Incoming and Current versions before choosing the result. 3: Edit Result to preserve both degrees and shortest-arc meaning. 4: Complete Merge stages the resolved file; review, test and commit afterward.
